concept: Business logic errors: code that passes low-level checks can still permit exploitable outcomes when a core invariant is missing or misapplied.
scene: Technical-style card on a deep navy background. A simple diagram shows a row of checkmarked boxes for type safety, reentrancy guard and access control, leading to a broken link labeled invariant in amber. A thin amber line traces the path from the passing checks to the gap. White text sits in the upper left with generous margin.
overlay_text: the code does what it says, but what it says permits exploitable outcomes
alt_text: Diagram of three passing checks leading to a broken amber link labeled invariant on a navy background, with the text: the code does what it says, but what it says permits exploitable outcomes.
